ex.s: The research, carried out by scientists at the Columbia Climate School and other institutions, found that if the city maintains past species patterns in new plantings, isoprene production in Manhattan in coming decades will go up by about 140%, and resulting summer ozone levels as much as 30%.

ex.s: All participants were then tested on how they process information, and whether it's in a more practical or abstract way.

ex.s: Across all participants, those in the beauty group scored almost 14% higher on average than the control group in abstract thinking.
ex.t: 在所有参与者中，美感组在抽象思维上的平均得分比对照组高出近14%。

ex.s: Among those, the effect was greater: those with an artistic hobby in the beauty group scored over 25% higher on average for abstract thinking than those with an artistic hobby in the control group.
ex.t: 在这些人中，效果更明显：美感组中有艺术爱好的人，其抽象思维平均得分比对照组中有艺术爱好的人高出25%以上。

ex.s: Across all participants, those in the beauty group reported an average of 23% higher levels of “transformative and self-transcendent feelings” — such as feeling moved, enlightened and inspired — than the control group.
ex.t: 在所有参与者中，美感组报告的“蜕变性和超越自我的感受”——如感动、受启迪、受鼓舞——平均比对照组高出23%。

ex.s: “We usually think in very concrete terms when doing something on a screen,” said Simone Schnall, senior author of the study.
ex.t: “我们在屏幕上做事时，通常以非常具体的方式思考，”该研究的资深作者Simone Schnall说。

ex.t: Rachel的声音里带着真诚的温暖，她说他们可以带Emily去一家他们熟悉的附近咖啡馆。

ex.s: Each subject got eight reviews to read: a balanced set of two positive fake, two positive real, two negative fake and two negative real, presented in a random order.
